headline: Committee rewrites South Maui plan shelter, housing and compost actions

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Strike action 2.18 and add it as a policy under Goal 2.2
meeting.summary: Committee rewrites South Maui plan shelter, housing and compost actions.
meeting.recap: The committee reconvened a recessed meeting that started September 21st, 2026.[[0:00:29]] Members continued reviewing Bill 108, the South Maui Community Plan update.[[0:07:03]] Members settled on wording to build at least one puʻuhonua or culturally infused safe low barrier shelter.[[0:57:29]] That change passed 8–0.[[1:00:59]] The committee voted 8–0 to make action 2.18 a policy supporting permits for a South Maui composting program.[[1:47:44]] Action 2.19, about that parcel, was set aside for a later revisit.[[2:19:31]] The amended motion, using "must" instead of "may," passed 8–0.[[2:37:36]]
decided: The committee moved action 2.18 into the policies to support land use entitlements for a green waste and compost program in South Maui.
Members kept action 2.21 on exceptional trees as written.
meeting.next: The council chair plans to collect questions for an executive session (a closed-door discussion). Staff will add islandwide composting to the list of possible General Plan items. A county official said they will check with county archaeologists about past surveys and report back. The Management staff member was asked to lead talks with Housing and other departments on action 2.19 and gulch buffer language. Members asked to note the arborist and arborist committee question on the list for after the South Maui plan. The committee will reconvene on the same Teams link, with in-person viewing in the Council Chambers.
